a: Robert Murray M'Cheyne (1813–1843) yali omuweereza wa St Peter's, Dundee, ajjukirwa olw'okunoonya kwe obutukuvu bwe ye n'okulabirira abantu kwe okw'ekisa ng'omusumba. Yali muweereza okumala emyaka nga musanvu gyokka era n'afa ng'aweza emyaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, naye Abakristaayo ab'ebyasa bibiri bakuumye erinnya lye: okuyita mu Memoir mukwano gwe Andrew Bonar gye yakuŋŋaanya okuva mu lujjukiro lwe n'ebbaluwa ze, omuvubuka ali mu ntaana okuva mu 1843 akyayigiriza abaweereza kye beetaaga okusinga era kye batasobola kwekolera — obutukuvu.

Yazaalibwa nga 21 May 1813 mu Edinburgh, ng'omwana asembayo obuto owa munnamateeka, era yali muyizi wa magezi amangu, alina ebirabo, naye ataafaayo. Enkyukakyuka mu bulamu bwe yajja olw'okufa okwabaawo mu maka ge: muganda we omukulu David, eyali atya Katonda era eyali amwegayiridde ku bikwata ku mwoyo gwe, yafa olw'omusujja nga 8 July 1831, era ennaku eyo yakola ekyo empaka kye zaali zitasobodde. Ku lunaku olw'okujjukira yawandiika oluvannyuma nti: "Ku lunaku luno emyaka kkumi n'ogumu emabega, nafiirwa muganda wange gwe nayagala era eyanjagala, ne ntandika okunoonya Muganda atayinza kufa."

q: Yatuuka atya ku St Peter's, Dundee?
a: Mu butiti obwa 1831 yayingira mu Divinity Hall eya University of Edinburgh wansi wa Thomas Chalmers, omusajja wa kkanisa ow'amaanyi ennyo mu mulembe ogwo. Yaweebwa olukusa okubuulira nga 1 July 1835, n'aweereza ng'omuyambi e Larbert ne Dunipace, era nga 24 November 1836 n'ayawulibwa okuba omuweereza wa St Peter's, Dundee — kkanisa empya mu kibuga ekijjudde abantu era eky'amakolero, eky'obwavu n'omwenge, emyoyo enkumi n'enkumi nga gitegekeddwa omusajja ow'emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu.

q: Obukakafu bwe ku butukuvu bwali butya?
a: Ekyuma ekyali wansi w'obuweereza bwe kyali kikwekeddwa, era kye kintu kye yasinga okufaako: entambula ye ye ne Katonda. Yali akakasizza nti abantu be kye baali beetaaga okuva gy'ali si kwe kugonjoola kwe oba obukugu bwe obw'okwogera, wabula obutukuvu bwe ye — nti okufaanana kw'omusumba ne Kristo kwe kyali ekikozesebwa Katonda ky'akozesa ddala. Yateeka omusingi ogwo mu bigambo ebigobereranga abaweereza okuva olwo: "Si birabo bikulu Katonda by'asinga okuwa omukisa nga bwe yeeyagaza okufaanana Yesu ennyo. Omuweereza omutukuvu kyokulwanyisa eky'entiisa mu mukono gwa Katonda."

q: Yanoonya atya obutukuvu obwo mu ye yennyini?
a: Okwetaaga okwo teyakulaga eri abalala wabula eri ye yennyini. Yagolokokanga mu makya okusaba n'okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa, yakuumanga olujjukiro olw'okwekebera, ng'akuuma omutima gwe n'obukambwe bwe yali atakozesa ku balala, era yeeteekerateekeranga Ssabbiiti ng'omuntu atalina buyinza kuyingira ku kituuti n'obutafaayo. Okusaba kwe kukiraga: "Emirundi mingi nsaba nti, Mukama, nfuula omutukuvu nga omwonoonyi asonyiyiddwa bw'ayinza okufuulibwa" — okusaba kw'omuntu eyamanya bulungi kye yali, asonyiyiddwa era ne kitali kirala, era eyayagala buli kantu konna okusonyiyibwa kw'akuleetera okusoboka.

q: Kiki ekyabaawo mu lugendo lwe olwa 1839 eri Abayudaaya?
a: Mu 1839 Ekkanisa ey'e Sukotirandi yatuma ekibinja ekitono, M'Cheyne ng'ali mu bo wamu ne Andrew Bonar, ku lugendo olw'okunoonyereza ku mbeera y'Abayudaaya mu Palestine ne mu nsi ez'ebuvanjuba w'ennyanja Mediterranean; yava mu kkanisa ye okuva mu April okutuuka mu November. Olugendo oluzibu lwayamba okutandikawo obuweereza bwa Sukotirandi eri Abayudaaya — naye ekintu ekikulu ekyabaawo mu 1839 kyabaawo e St Peter's nga taliiwo: wansi w'okubuulira kwa William Chalmers Burns eyali alabirira ekituuti, okuzuukuka kwabalukawo mu August ne kuyita mu kibuga kyonna.

Yali amaze ebbanga ddene ng'asaba era ng'akola olw'okuzuukuka mu bantu be, naye tekwajja; oluvannyuma ne kujja wansi w'okubuulira kw'omuntu omulala ng'ali mayiro bikumi n'ebikumi wala. Bwe yakomawo mu November, teyakomawo mu kkanisa gye yali alese wabula mu kkuŋŋaaniro erikyusiddwa — ery'azuukuse, erikaaba amaziga, erinoonya Katonda mu muwendo gwe yali asabidde naye n'atalaba. Omuntu atali kumpi na Katonda nnyo yandinakuwadde nti si mukono gwe ogwali ku makungula; M'Cheyne yakitwala ng'ekirabo ekirongoofu ddala n'awa Katonda okwebaza.

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okuwangaala bye yakola kyali kimu ku ebyo ebyayinga obwangu: mu 1842 yakola kalanda ak'okusomera Bayibuli yonna mu mwaka gumu, akaakubibwa ku ntandikwa ya 1843 ku lw'ekkuŋŋaaniro lye era n'akatuuma "Daily Bread." Kaali kateeka ebitundu bina buli lunaku — bibiri olw'okusinza kw'amaka na bibiri olw'okusoma kw'obuntu. Kye yali ayagala tekyali kumaliriza kwokka wabula n'okubeera awamu: nti abantu be bonna "baliire mu kitundu kimu eky'omuddo omugadde mu kiseera kye kimu." Kakyakozesebwa nnyo n'okutuusa leero.

Obulamu bwe bwali tebunnywera, era mu 1843 Dundee kyalumbibwa kawumpuli wa typhus. M'Cheyne teyayagala kwewala balwadde; yeeyongera okukyalira abaalumbibwa omusujja mu bantu be era n'akwatibwa endwadde okuva gye bali. Ennaku bbiri oluvannyuma lw'okubuulira nga 12 March 1843 yakwatibwa omusujja, era n'afa nga 25 March, nga wakyabulayo wiiki ntono okutuuka ku lunaku lwe olw'amazaalibwa ag'amakumi asatu. Ennaku ey'ekibuga yali ya kyewuunyo — abantu nga kasanvu baajja ku kuziikibwa kwe mu luggya lwa St Peter's.

q: Lwaki ajjukirwa so nga abasajja abaakola ennyo beerabirwa?
a: Kubanga kye yawa Katonda tekyali kutuukiriza wabula ye yennyini. Bw'ogeraga mu ngeri eya bulijjo yatuukiriza bitono nnyo — kkanisa emu, emyaka mitono, ekinywa ky'ebbaluwa, akalanda k'okusoma Bayibuli, n'entaana eyajja mu bwangu — kyokka Memoir Bonar gye yafulumya omwaka ogwaddirira okufa kwe yafuuka kimu ku bitabo eby'Ekikristaayo ebyasinga okukwata ku bantu mu kyasa eky'ekkumi n'omwenda. "Beera kumpi ne Katonda," bwe yawandiika, "kale ebintu byonna binaakulabikira nga bitono bw'obigeraganya n'ebintu eby'emirembe n'emirembe" — omulimu gwa buli lunaku ogw'obulamu bwe obumpi nga gufunziddwa mu sentensi emu.
